# F1 regression fixtures

Captured directly from Jolpica-F1 and OpenF1 during W03 on 2026-10-30 UTC
(2026-10-29 America/Los_Angeles). URLs, capture times, original response SHA-256
and committed fixture SHA-256 are in `manifest.json`. Media URLs, upstream URL
fields and XML namespace fields were removed; sporting values are unchanged.

Attribution: Jolpica-F1 (https://api.jolpi.ca), OpenF1 (https://openf1.org).
Source data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; fixtures are provided under the same license.
No FIA PDFs, photos, credentials or full telemetry are included.

These are supplier snapshots, not an independent FIA-final verification. W02's
observed cases informed assertions; W03 re-fetched the JSON. Tests of errors,
future sessions, revisions and malformed payloads mutate copies or use synthetic
HTTP responses, and are not claims about observed supplier outages or latency.
The 1950 shared car pairs are explicitly scoped to Britain (cars 10 and 9).
Do not generalize these samples to complete field coverage in every season.
